chunks: Or some other created thing which may seem to you most difficult (to create)! They will then say: 'Who will revert us back?' Say: 'He who originated you in the first place.' They will shake their heads at you and say: 'When will that be?' Say: 'In the near future, perhaps.'

key_terms.فَطَرَکُمْ: originated you / created you from nothing

ai.seo_question: Who will resurrect humanity according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Surah Al--Isra, this verse highlights the psychological resistance of the disbelievers, who reduce the concept of resurrection to a mere physical reassembly of bones or dust, asking 'Who will restore us?' with a tone of skepticism. The divine response anchors the miracle in the Creator's initial act of creation (al-khalq al-awwal), a theme central to Shia theological discourse on the ease of resurrection for the All-Powerful. The phrase 'perhaps it is near' (ʿasā an yakūna qarībā) reflects the eschatological tension in Shia tradition, balancing the certainty of the event with the unpredictability of its timing to encourage constant spiritual readiness.
